title_english: Electric Power Industry Reform Act of 2001
notes: Framework law: unbundles NPC, creates ERC, WESM, PSALM and TransCo; Sec. 31 sets retail competition and open access. Approval date from Lawphil text. Statutory amendments found so far touch only the lifeline rate (RA 10150 of 2011-06-21, not a row yet; RA 11552). EPIRA amendment bills still pending in Congress as of 2026-07.

title_english: Act Extending and Enhancing the Implementation of the Lifeline Rate, amending Section 73 of RA 9136 as amended by RA 10150
notes: Extends the lifeline (subsidised) rate for poor households. Also amends RA 10150, which is not yet a row.

title_english: Renewable Energy Act of 2008
notes: Sets up RPS, feed-in tariffs, the Green Energy Option (Sec. 9) and net metering (Sec. 10). Its IRR is DOE DC2009-05-0008, amended by DC2022-11-0034 and DC2025-09-0014. Not yet checked whether the Act itself was amended by statute.

title_english: Amending Section 19 of the Rules and Regulations Implementing RA 9513 (Renewable Energy Act of 2008)
notes: Allows up to 100% foreign ownership in solar, wind, hydro and ocean/tidal projects, following DOJ Opinion 21 s.2022. Amends the RE Act IRR (DC2009-05-0008, not a row). The official title and the DOE page were not reached (on the old DOE site); the date comes from Baker McKenzie and news reports. Water permits for hydro stay limited to entities that are 60% Filipino-owned. The 'framework-law' topic fits only loosely.

title_english: Adopting and Prescribing the Policy for the Competitive Selection Process in the Procurement by the Distribution Utilities of Power Supply Agreement for the Captive Market
notes: Title as given on the old DOE page and in DC2021-09-0030; not fetched (legacy.doe.gov.ph unreachable). Day of signing not confirmed. DC2023-06-0021 repeals it 'upon the effectivity of the ERC guidelines' (ERC Res. 16 s.2023), so the exact revocation date depends on that resolution.

title_english: Prescribing the Policy for the Mandatory Conduct of the Competitive Selection Process by the Distribution Utilities for the Procurement of Power Supply for Their Captive Market
notes: Date from the NARO register and DC2025-10-0022. Repealing clause (checked by OCR) also repeals DC2015-06-0008, DC2021-09-0030 and DC2022-06-0027 (not rows), effective once the ERC guidelines take effect. ERC companion rule: Res. 16 s.2023.

title_english: Prescribing Policies to Enhance the Procurement of Power Supply by Distribution Utilities for the Captive Market, Amending and Supplementing for this Purpose DC2023-06-0021
notes: Text read on the DOE page and PDF. Published 2025-10-26; exact signing day not read.

title_english: Promulgating the Rules and Guidelines Governing the Establishment of the Renewable Portfolio Standards for On-Grid Areas
notes: Signing date as recited in DOE DC2020-10-0022 and DC2025-10-0020. Requires DUs and suppliers to source a rising share from eligible RE (1% a year at first). DC2022-09-0030 (signed 2022-09-23 per news) raised the increment to 2.52% from 2023; that circular is not a row yet.

title_english: Prescribing the Amendments to DC2017-12-0015 or the Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS) Rules for On-Grid Areas
notes: Date issued as given in the UP Law Center NARO register (filed 2023-06-05). Content not yet read. A separate DC2023-05-0014 revised the off-grid RPS rules.

title_english: Promulgating the Guidelines Governing the Policy for the Conduct of Green Energy Auction in the Philippines
notes: First GEA guidelines. Published 2020-07-29; the signing day is blank in the PDF copy. Repealed by DC2021-11-0036, Sec. 22.

title_english: Providing the Revised Guidelines for the Green Energy Auction Program in the Philippines
notes: Signing date from the PDF ('Issued on NOV 3 2021'). Amended by DC2023-09-0027 (2023-09-26) and DC2025-03-0004 (2025-03-07), which are not rows. ERC sets the GEAR ceiling prices for each round by resolution.

title_english: Providing Specific Auction Policy and Guidelines for Non-FIT-Eligible Renewable Energy Technologies in the Green Energy Auction Program
notes: Date issued as given in NARO, even though the number contains '-10-'. Amended by DC2024-09-0028 (2024-09-10) and, per NARO, DC2024-03-0010 (2024-03-25). The DOE site lists a different title for DC2024-03-0010 (E20 gasoline), which needs checking.

title_english: Promulgating the Rules and Guidelines Governing the Establishment of the Green Energy Option Program Pursuant to the Renewable Energy Act of 2008
notes: Signing date as recited in DC2024-03-0009 and DC2026-01-0002. Lets end-users of 100 kW and above choose an RE supplier. Official copy is on the old DOE site (not reachable); the source link is a secondary database. Repealed by DC2026-01-0002, Sec. 28, together with DC2020-04-0009 (RE supplier permits, 2020-04-22).

title_english: Promulgating the Revised Rules and Guidelines Governing the Implementation of the Green Energy Option Program
notes: Read by OCR of the PDF: lowers the eligibility threshold to 50 kW with an annual review, and repeals DC2018-07-0019 and DC2020-04-0009. Published 2026-02-06; signing day not read.

title_english: A Resolution Adopting the Omnibus Rules for Customer Choice Programs in the Retail Market
notes: Date from NARO. According to DC2026-01-0002 it consolidates ERC issuances on RCOA and GEOP. It may supersede ERC Res. 08 s.2021 (GEOP rules, 2021-04-22); not yet checked.

title_english: Declaring the Commercial Operations Date of Retail Competition and Open Access (RCOA) and Green Energy Option Program (GEOP) in Mindanao
notes: Sets 2024-03-26 as the start of RCOA and GEOP in the Mindanao grid (read by OCR). The DOE page heading shows a wrong title (petroleum allowances); the PDF and NARO are correct.

title_english: Guidelines on Virtual Power Purchase Agreements
notes: VPPAs here are contracts to buy voluntary RECs; power still flows through WESM or other regulated channels (draft-stage reporting; check against the final text). Date from the PDF (OCR) and Enviliance.

title_english: Adopting the Amendments to the Rules Enabling the Net-Metering Program for Renewable Energy
notes: Date and title as recited in DOE DC2020-10-0022 and DC2024-08-0025; ERC site blocked (Cloudflare), so the source link is the DOE circular that cites it. Amends ERC Res. 9 s.2013 (2013-05-27), the original net-metering rules (not a row). Net metering covers systems up to 100 kW.

title_english: A Resolution Amending ERC Resolution No. 6, Series of 2019 (Amended Net-Metering Rules)
notes: Known only from the recital in DOE DC2025-10-0020; ERC text not seen.

title_english: Prescribing the Policies to Enhance the Net-Metering Program for Renewable Energy Systems
notes: Date as recited in DC2024-08-0025 and DC2025-10-0020. Published 2021-02-24.

title_english: Prescribing Further Policies to Enhance the Net-Metering Program for Renewable Energy Systems, Amending for This Purpose DC2020-10-0022
notes: Deals with the banking of net-metering credits and the REC meter (per DC2025-10-0020). Date from the PDF ('AUG 19 2024') and NARO.

title_english: Supplemental Policy to the Net-Metering Program Integrating Renewable Energy Certificate Trading and Multi-Site and Aggregate Net-Metering to Enhance Participant Benefits and Market Access
notes: RECs from own use go to the end-user and RECs from exported power go to the DU. RECs can be traded on the RE Market. Credits can be shared across one user's accounts in the same franchise area. It supplements rather than formally amends DC2020-10-0022. Published 2025-10-19.

title_english: Prescribing the Policy and General Framework on the Expanded Roof-Mounted Solar Program in the Philippines
notes: Read by OCR of the PDF. Takes effect on publication (2024-01-03); signing day blank in the copy. The DOE page shows a mismatched second title.

title_english: Policy Guidelines for Self-Generating Facility Zero-Export Solar Systems and Micro-Solar Systems for Own-Use
notes: Newest rooftop rule, for own-use solar that does not export to the grid. Takes effect on publication. Asks the ERC to issue rules within 90 days. Signing day not read.

title_english: DOE Advisory on the moratorium on endorsements for greenfield coal-fired power projects
notes: Announced 2020-10-27 and applied from then. The written advisory is dated 2020-12-22 and was released 2021-01-11 (news). It is a DOE advisory, not a circular, so 'decision' is a stand-in. Exact title and DOE URL not confirmed; old DOE node links now return a 'Page Not Found' page with HTTP 200. Expansions of existing plants and committed projects are excluded.

title_english: DOE Advisory clarifying the coverage of the coal moratorium policy
notes: Per news reports, lists exempt cases: off-grid, own-use or self-generation, critical-mineral processing, and on-grid projects needed to avoid shortfalls. DOE said in 2026-05 that the moratorium stays. 'amends' is our reading: it narrows the 2020 advisory without replacing it. Advisory text not seen.

title_english: Philippine Energy Plan 2023-2050
notes: Three volumes. The clean energy scenario targets 35% RE in generation by 2030 and 50% by 2040, plus nuclear and offshore wind. Drafted and consulted on in 2023; a revised edition was reported in 2024-07. The exact adoption date is not confirmed, the PDF is on the old site (not fetched), and the new DOE site's PEP link is broken. The companion Power Development Plan 2023-2050 is not a row yet (date unknown).

title_english: Prescribing the Policy for Categorization of Energy Resources and Technologies in the Energy Mix to Enhance Sufficiency of Generation, Adequacy and Reliability of Supply for Electric Power
notes: Covers how the PDP is prepared and updated (Sec. 5), and how DU power supply procurement plans and distribution development plans must align (Secs. 4, 6). Read from the PDF text layer; there is no clear statement of what it amends. Published in the Official Gazette 2026-02-19.

title_english: Directing the Establishment of the Policy and Administrative Framework for Offshore Wind Development
notes: Implemented by DOE DC2023-06-0020 (2023-06-16, NARO), not a row yet. The first offshore-wind auction, GEA-5, followed (ERC GEAR price reported as PHP 11.00/kWh in 2026-02; resolution not seen). Topics fit loosely.

title_english: Policy on Allowing Generation Companies to Finance and Construct Associated Transmission Projects for the Timely Integration of Power Projects Critical to the Country's Energy Transition and Supply Security
notes: Date from the PDF ('Issued this 07 day of January 2026', OCR). Companion DC2026-02-0007 lets TransCo finance and build transmission.
